name: Grade 9 IIT: Data Collection and Cleaning
description: Data science, data questions, investigative cycle, survey items, data types, privacy rules, collection methods, tables, headings, units, missing values, cleaning, and change logs.

words.definition: Using data to investigate questions and support decisions.
words.example: Data science helped the class analyze survey results.

words.definition: Facts, numbers, text, or observations that can be used.
words.example: The survey collected data from students.

words.definition: Data that has been organized or explained so it is useful.
words.example: The chart turned data into information.

words.definition: A problem or idea that data can help answer.
words.example: The data question had to be measurable.

words.definition: A process for answering a question using data.
words.example: The cycle included problem, plan, data, analysis, and conclusion.

words.definition: A prepared method for collecting or analyzing data.
words.example: The plan listed five survey items.

words.definition: A set of questions used to collect data from people.
words.example: The survey asked about school habits.

words.definition: A value collected by observing or using a tool.
words.example: Height was a measurement in centimeters.

words.definition: The kind of data being collected, such as number, category, or text.
words.example: Favorite subject is a category data type.

words.definition: Protection of personal or sensitive information.
words.example: The plan included one privacy rule.

words.definition: Data arranged in rows and columns.
words.example: The dataset was organized in a table.

words.definition: A label that names a column or section.
words.example: Clear headings helped explain the table.

words.definition: A measurement label such as cm, seconds, or dollars.
words.example: The column heading included the unit.

words.definition: A group or type used to organize data.
Data that should be present but is blank or unavailable.
words.example: The missing value had to be checked before analysis.

words.definition: Fixing or removing incorrect, missing, or unclear data.
A record of edits made to data or a project.
words.example: The change log listed cleaned values.

words.definition: How accurate, complete, and useful data is.
